name: Bundle-aware free gift settings
description: Configure bundle exclusion, line-property free gift, and vanity competition
title: Bundle-aware free gift
helpText: Gift lines are identified by a line item property. Collection-pair bundle units are excluded first. The gift gets the real discount; other non-bundle lines get a $0.01 vanity discount so this function competes as one group against discount codes.
bundleHelpText: Products in this collection that form a live collection-pair / hoodie bundle are excluded before free-gift and vanity discounts. Must match the live bundle discount collection.
bundlePriceNote: Used for artificial min-spend after pairs (shop currency). Must match the live bundle discount.
linePropertyRequired: Line item property key is required
minSpendInvalid: Minimum spend must be zero or greater
minSpendHelp: Based on non-gift lines after simulated bundle pricing. Gift lines do not count toward spend.
discountMessageHelp: Shown on the free-gift line. Vanity lines use no message.
redemptionsOneNote: Customers get one free gift when artificial spend reaches the minimum.
redemptionsMultipleNote: Customers get one free gift for each multiple of the minimum spend.
